entities.summary: Elisa Soriano Fisher was a Spanish teacher and ophthalmologist. She founded the Asociación Nacional de Mujeres Españolas and was the president of the Juventud Universitaria Femenina association. She is considered a leading figure of universal suffrage and associative and intellectual feminism of the 1920s and 1930s, until the beginning of the Spanish Civil War.
